- [FACT] User used a recipe from King Arthur Flour's website for their sourdough bread.

- [PREFERENCE] User is looking for tips on making a good ciabatta.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Ciabatta is a classic Italian bread known for its airy holes and soft, slightly crispy crust.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for making ciabatta include using a preferment, high-protein flour, keeping the dough wet, gentle mixing, letting it rest, folding and shaping gently, crucial proofing, careful scoring, baking with steam, and cooling completely.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] A simple ciabatta recipe was provided, including ingredients and instructions:
  - Ingredients: 1 cup biga or poolish, 2 cups bread flour, 1 teaspoon salt, 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1 1/2 cups water.
  - Instructions: Mix biga or poolish with flour, salt, and olive oil; add water and mix until shaggy; autolyse for 20-30 minutes; fold and shape gently; proof for 1-2 hours; score and bake at 425°F (220°C) for 25-30 minutes with steam; cool completely on a wire rack.
- [PREFERENCE] User is thinking of making a batch of ciabatta to go with homemade strawberry jam.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Freshly baked ciabatta and homemade strawberry jam are a perfect pairing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggestions for additional toppings include butter, whipped cream, Nutella, peanut butter, or crumbled goat cheese with fresh herbs.
